discoveryEvidence: Founder 2026-11-14 11:35: two failing pull requests were sent to him.
impact: a pull request link that is not green reaches the founder
rootCause: pull requests were opened and linked outside the green-gated producer; no sender checked the head's checks
immediateCorrection: Guard tests added and run by the pre-commit hook.
compensatingControl: argon .githooks/pre-commit runs every recurrenceGuards test of every defect (tests/test_failure_classes.py); a removed, renamed or failing guard refuses the commit.
rolloutEvidence: argon lane/flow-guarantees-20261114 (pull request 112); the hook refused a commit when a guard failed.
residualRisk: Only argon's 7 Telegram senders pass the gate. A sweep on 2026-11-14 found 106 more in 12 repositories (estate-guards:5 hermes-agent:13 hermes-config:7 hermes-v2:4 idp:35 idp-archive:28 sentinel-loop:6 survival-stack:2 maestro:2 crew:2 prospector:1 estate-graph:1) and 4 private repositories unscanned; until one egress holds the founder's bot tokens, those paths can still deliver a red link.

discoveryEvidence: idp#8101 was pushed while a local run of bin/dof-gate on the same range was already known to refuse it; the agent announced the push and stopped watching.
impact: Red builds reach review and the founder; failures that recur hundreds of times are normalised.
rootCause: Nothing ran the repository's CI checks before the push, and nothing required the pushing agent to watch its checks to a verdict.
immediateCorrection: bin/genesis-pr-door.py predicts every required check locally from .genesis/pr-door.json and refuses on the first red; argon's pre-push hook runs it; watch reports GREEN, RED or PENDING and nothing is announced before GREEN.
compensatingControl: argon .githooks/pre-push runs the door on every pushed ref; tests/test_genesis_pr_door.py proves a predicted red is never pushed and that idp's mirrors cover every check that turned idp#8101 red.
rolloutEvidence: argon lane/flow-guarantees-20261114; the door refused this lane's own push when the lineage floor dropped.
residualRisk: A hook runs only where it is installed; idp's pre-push cannot take the door while idp is repair-only. Pushes from clones without hooks are caught after the fact by watch, not prevented.

discoveryEvidence: An agent answered exhausted provider lanes by rewriting model names into router config; argon itself carried the policy's model IDs typed into 6 code and launch files, and genesis-lead read a lane the policy never declared then used a typed-in name every time.
impact: A provider change, outage or quota breaks every place a name was typed, and the policy stops being the authority on which model a lane uses.
rootCause: Code took model names as literals with the policy as an optional override, so nothing forced one source.
immediateCorrection: bin/genesis_models.py reads lanes from genesis-agent-policy.json; the concierge, lead, launch config, server and panel no longer carry model IDs; an undeclared lane is an error, and the lead no longer calls the Gemini API the policy marks subscription-only.
compensatingControl: tests/test_no_hardcoded_models.py refuses a model ID in any tracked code or launch file outside the policy; its allowance (the router's catalog seed) may only shrink.
residualRisk: Covers argon only; the same scan over the other estate repositories has not run. Agents in third-party web chats are outside any estate gate until their work enters through an estate door.
